test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 19 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A town has a present population of 2,40,000. Every year the population increases by a birth rate of 12% and decreases by a death rate of 7%. Find the population of the town at the end of 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Initial population = 240000

Birth rate = 12%

Death rate = 7%

Time = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Net increase = (1 + increase/100) × (1 - decrease/100)

Population after t years = P × (net factor)t

**Calculation:**

⇒ Net factor = 1.12 × 0.93

⇒ Net factor = 1.0416

⇒ Population after 3 years = 240000 × (1.0416)³

⇒ (1.0416)² = 1.085

⇒ (1.0416)³ = 1.130

⇒ Population = 240000 × 1.130

⇒ Population = 271200

**∴ The correct answer is 271200.**
